Eli (Sales): Quick handoff — TideTurn (midmarket fintech) signed last week. Passing to CS for onboarding + runway/renewal visibility. They want a private deploy in our EU region.
Maya (CS): Thanks Eli. Do we have the SSO and data connector specs?
Eli (Sales): SSO is Okta, but customer asks for specific attributes (email, employee_id, role). They also want an initial data push from their analytics pipeline — 100k rows. Demo was green but they hit an error on staging when we tested large batch.
Jonah (CS Ops): Noted. Could you drop the staging error log? helps triage.
Eli (Sales): pasted the error snippet below.
```
ERROR: ingest.batch failed: KV timeout on write: shard-3
stack: redis.Client.TimeoutError at ingest.batch (server/ingest.js:87)
```
Maya (CS): That looks like the ingress side hitting a shard limit. I'll schedule a deep-dive with Eng. Priya — can you own the connector investigation?
Priya (Support Eng): I can. Initial hypothesis: our private connector in EU uses older redis config. I'll repro against their sample dataset.
Maya (CS): Thanks. Owners & asks:
- Maya: onboarding lead & enablement session owner
- Priya: connector + staging fail root cause
- Jonah: infra pre-provisioning for private deploy in eu-west-1 (expected GPU: 1 x A10)
- Eli: customer PM and contract contacts + acceptance criteria doc
Maya (CS): Renewal signal: they included a 12-month plan but mentioned exploring alternatives if onboarding >6 weeks. Marking renewal risk = medium-high. Need onboarding within 4 weeks to be safe.
Eli (Sales): Customer success metrics they care about: 1) ingestion throughput 2) end-to-end latency < 200ms for 95th pct 3) feature parity with hosted API for function-calling. Also they want a white-glove enablement session for 3 engineers.
Jonah (CS Ops): I'll pre-create the infra ticket. Sketch of infra tasks: VPC peering, subnet policy, KMS key creation, private deploy config (quantization profile: q4_0), and a canary route to hosted fallback.
Priya (Support Eng): Timeline estimate — repro and quick fix 3 business days if it’s redis config; otherwise 7–10 days for codepath fixes. Will update with first repro by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (CS): Enablement plan: two 90-min sessions (dev onboarding, production runbook) + runbook doc + a short acceptance test suite we'll run with them. I'll create calendar invites once dates are confirmed. @Eli, can you confirm 3 engineers' availability windows next week?
Eli (Sales): Confirmed: Tue/Wed mornings PT. Sending names in DM.
deploy-bot: onboarding-template created: /playbooks/onboarding/tideturn-v1 (owner: Maya).
calendar-bot: Provisional invites created for Tue 09:00 PT and Wed 09:00 PT — pending attendee confirmations.
Maya (CS): Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: SSO attribute mismatch -> Mitigation: pre-flight test with their IdP; owner: Maya
- Risk: Ingest timeout on large batches -> Mitigation: Priya to test batching window + increase shard timeout + fallback to streaming mode; owner: Priya
- Risk: Renewal at risk if onboarding delayed -> Mitigation: executive sponsor check-in and weekly status; owner: Eli + Maya
Maya (CS): Action items (short):
1) Priya: reproduce ingest error and propose fix (due: 2026-03-24)
2) Jonah: open infra ticket and reserve eu-west-1 dev capacity (due: 2026-03-23)
3) Maya: send enablement invites and acceptance test template (due: 2026-03-22)
4) Eli: share engineer contact details + test dataset (due: 2026-03-22)
Priya (Support Eng): Ack — I'll post repro logs and a PR link if code changes needed.
Jonah (CS Ops): Ack — tagging infra: #eng-infra for assistance on KMS/VPC.
Maya (CS): Quick note on feedback capture: they gave NPS-like feedback after demo -> "really impressed with latency but worried about data safety during onboarding". We'll capture this in the post-onboard survey and escalate any compliance asks to security.
Eli (Sales): Good. I'll loop in their legal contact for DPA and share our standard checklist.
Maya (CS): Closing comment: team — please update the onboarding playbook with any config deltas we discover so next handoff is smoother. :thumbsup:
Priya (Support Eng): Will do. Posting first repro by EOD.
Eli (Sales): Thanks all, leaving it with CS + Eng.
Maya (CS): Thanks — picking this up now, will post status updates in this thread.
